location: scripts/ci-failed-jobs.sh:NEW planned from plan.txt:25-30 and scripts/ship-pr.sh:NEW planned from plan.txt:80
what: Shard suffix extraction is underspecified before LOCAL_CMD reaches eval
scenario_or_breakage: A permissive strip such as removing text after the first parenthesized suffix can turn raw job name test-harnesses (7; rm -rf /) into base test-harnesses and shard 7; rm -rf /, producing LOCAL_CMD make test-harnesses-7; rm -rf / that run_per_job_local_fix_loop then executes with eval
suggested_fix: Add an explicit normalization contract and tests: only accept exactly ^test-harnesses \(([0-9]+)\)$, require a nonempty digit-only shard, and classify malformed suffixes like test-harnesses () or test-harnesses (7; rm -rf /) as no-local-equivalent or parser-error before LOCAL_CMD construction

location: scripts/ci-failed-jobs.sh:NEW planned from plan.txt:42 and scripts/ship-pr.sh:NEW planned from plan.txt:80
what: The TSV handoff does not escape job names before parsing LOCAL_CMD and CLASS
scenario_or_breakage: A raw job name containing literal tabs can shift columns; for example an unknown job name shaped with tab-separated fields could be emitted before its no-local-equivalent columns, and the ship-pr TSV reader may see a different LOCAL_CMD and CLASS=fixable than ci-failed-jobs intended
suggested_fix: Do not use raw tab-delimited job names for this trust boundary; use JSON with jq, NUL-delimited records, or percent/base64 encode every field, and add regression tests with literal tab and newline job names proving CLASS and LOCAL_CMD cannot be field-shifted

what: The proposed runner executes serialized command strings with eval
scenario_or_breakage: The case catchall only protects strings that survive normalization and TSV parsing correctly; any bug in those earlier steps becomes shell execution because eval interprets metacharacters in LOCAL_CMD
suggested_fix: Carry structured fields instead of shell strings and dispatch with argv arrays in ship-pr, e.g. case job plus validated shard then run make "test-harnesses-$shard"; if LOCAL_CMD remains for display, never eval it

what: The plan maps lint-mermaid to make lint-mermaid but the repository has no lint-mermaid Makefile target
scenario_or_breakage: A real lint-mermaid CI failure would be classified fixable, then the local command would fail with no rule to make target lint-mermaid rather than rerunning the CI-equivalent commands from the workflow
suggested_fix: Add a Makefile lint-mermaid target matching the workflow steps, or map lint-mermaid to an existing structured runner that performs npm ci when needed, scripts/lint-mermaid-fences.sh --changed-only, and bash scripts/test-pipe-sigpipe-safety.sh
